text: Loved... or feared? Which one makes you stronger?
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Over five hundred years ago... Machiavelli asked this exact question.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Picture a new team leader. She wants everyone to like her... so she never says no.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Soon, deadlines slip... and nobody takes her seriously.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: His answer: It is much safer to be feared than loved... when, of the two, either must be dispensed with.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: But here's the catch... In the same chapter, he says: avoid hatred.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: A wise prince should establish himself on that which is in his own control... and not in that of others.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Love depends on others. Respect... you can earn. Clear, fair standards... every single day.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Your action for today: set one clear standard... and keep it. Calmly.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Loved... or respected? Which would you choose? Tell me in the comments.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Follow Awaaz... for your daily mindset.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural
